product.title: Kyoto 4hr Private Tour with Government-Licensed Guide

description.text: In Kyoto, this private four-hour circuit pairs a government-licensed guide with a published half-day stop list rather than a full coach loop. The group chooses two or three sights such as Nishiki Market, Kiyomizu-dera Temple, Gion, Nijo Castle, or Fushimi Inari-taisha Shrine, then moves between them on foot and public transport. Hotel-front pickup on foot is listed; a private car is an optional upgrade booked in advance. Guide entry fees apply only to the listed What to Expect sights. The format suits visitors who want a compact licensed window without assembling a full-day temple circuit. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Kyoto, and the itinerary stays on Nishiki Market, Kiyomizu-dera, and Gion that define this half-day rather than an Arashiyama transfer.

highlights: Private four-hour circuit with a government-licensed Kyoto guide
Choose two or three published stops such as Nishiki Market, Kiyomizu-dera, or Gion
Half-day pacing instead of a full coach loop
Meet on foot in the designated Kyoto area
Transportation and most entrance fees listed separately

start.description: Meet the licensed guide on foot within the designated Kyoto area listed when booking. Public transportation or local taxis may be used between sites.

end.description: Return to your Kyoto meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
